This year marks the 18th annual World Autism Awareness Day.Throughout the month, we focus on sharing stories and providing opportunities to increase understanding and acceptance of people with autism and fostering worldwide support.Earn your Autism Ally BadgeTake our 30 minute Autism Friendly Training—developed with autistic people—to learn simple ways to make everyday spaces more welcoming. Whether you're at work, in a classroom, or at your local library, small actions can make a big impact.
